resources.text:
A - Subject A

DEMONSTRATION MATERIAL - NOT AN APPROVED SYLLABUS

Explore a lesson, try an activity, and check your understanding.

Learn
Read the lesson material and identify its main idea. Use the text companion whenever you prefer a readable text version.

Activity
Write a short explanation of one idea in your own words. In the learning workspace, mark the activity complete after doing the work.

Quiz
Submit your answer when ready. A quiz is marked submitted by the server; marking an activity complete does not create a quiz grade.

B - Subject B

DEMONSTRATION MATERIAL - NOT AN APPROVED SYLLABUS

Practice applying a concept to a simple situation.

Learn
Compare two possible approaches to a problem. Identify the evidence you need before choosing.

Activity
Describe your preferred approach and one observation that would make you reconsider it.

Quiz
Review the question and options. Submit once, then read the recorded result. Practice samples are separate from official learning records.

C - Subject C

DEMONSTRATION MATERIAL - NOT AN APPROVED SYLLABUS

Reflect on your work and plan the next learning step.

Learn
Review the lesson objective and connect it with something you have already learned.

Activity
Record one thing you understood and one question to ask your instructor. Mark completion only after doing the activity.

Quiz
Submit your own answer. Completion, submission, and achievement are separate states; a completed quiz is not necessarily a passing grade.
